title: sdks-unify-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.204.0
author: Priya Nair
description: Unify SDK auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and parity across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Motivation: several customers and internal teams hit subtle differences between SDKs around default auth headers, retry/backoff semantics, and streaming event types which makes cross-team debugging and client migrations harder. This PR standardizes behavior and API shape across all three SDKs, updates docs and changelogs, and bumps package versions to v1.204.0. Key changes: 1) Auth: single credential abstraction (CredentialProvider) with explicit refreshed/expired states and deterministic header signing; consistent env var names and precedence across SDKs. 2) Retries: standardized retry policy object with exponential backoff, jitter, idempotency-aware defaults, and max-retry quotas; consistent retryable error classification and telemetry tags. 3) Streaming: unified event model (data|progress|done|error) with typed messages and client-side helpers to assemble messages into higher-level objects; added backpressure hints in TS/Go where supported. 4) Ergonomics: convenience constructors, better typed generics in TypeScript, improved Python context manager for streaming clients, and Go helper utilities for common patterns. 5) Parity & version bump: aligned APIs and behavior, updated changelogs and migration notes, bumped Python/TS/Go SDKs to v1.204.0. The description below lists checks, testing notes, and migration guidance. Checklist: - [x] Implement CredentialProvider abstraction in python/ts/go - [x] Replace ad-hoc retry wrappers with unified RetryPolicy - [x] Add streaming event type and helpers - [x] Add cross-SDK integration tests + golden fixtures - [x] Update docs and CHANGELOGs - [x] Update examples and quickstarts - [x] Bump package versions and publish candidates Testing: unit and integration tests added across sdks; ran end-to-end mux tests against local dev server. CI: initial lint failures in TS (missing types) and flaky Go streaming test; fixed by tightening types and adding re-run with improved mocks. Migration notes: most users will be unaffected; if you relied on the old retry jitter behavior or consumed raw streaming frames, see docs/sdk/migration-v1.204.0.md for the upgrade path and helper adapters. Release notes included.

release_notes: Unified SDK auth + retry semantics; stabilized streaming event model; ergonomics improvements for Python (context-manager), TypeScript (stronger generics), and Go (helper utils); version bump to v1.204.0 for Python/TS/Go; see docs/sdk/migration-v1.204.0.md for upgrade notes.

migration_guide: See docs/sdk/migration-v1.204.0.md for step-by-step migration instructions. Key points: 1) Replace old RetryConfig with RetryPolicy helper or adapter. 2) Use CredentialProvider for long-lived token refresh; env var names unchanged but precedence standardized. 3) For streaming consumers that handled raw frames, switch to the typed event helpers or add an adapter layer.
notes_for_release_manager: Publish order: typescript -> python -> go to minimize user-facing churn for major web clients. Monitor streaming reconnect rates and retry telemetry for 48 hours after release. Post-merge action: cut release branches and coordinate marketplace updates.
